Assessor's Office
The Assessor's Office directs, plans and supervises the appraisal and recording of all property assessments in Chippewa County as prescribed by Minnesota Statutes and the directives of the Commissioners of Revenue in order to provide an equitable and efficient system of property appraisal for tax purposes.
Auditor/Treasurer/Coordinator's Office
The office of the County Auditor/Treasurer is an elected position, whose responsibilities are subject to various Minnesota State Statutes.
Building Maintenance
The Courthouse Maintenance Department takes care of the cleaning, maintenance, grounds keeping, heating, air conditioning and construction projects within the courthouse building.

Highway Department
The Chippewa County Highway Department is responsible for the construction and maintenance of the county roads and bridges.
Human Resources
Information Technology
The Information Technology Department is responsible for all facets of technology in Chippewa County including computer systems, networking, telecommunications and information services
Land & Resource Management
The Chippewa County Land and Resource Management Department is designed to perform the basic functions of implementation and enforcement of County, State, and Federal regulations that relate to planning, zoning, solid and hazardous waste, water planning, and safety issues.
License Bureau
Obtain information about licenses in Chippewa County.
Recorder's Office
The County Recorder is the custodian of all records of the county pertaining to property title and transfers.
Restorative Justice
The goal of the Chippewa County Restorative Justice and Mentoring Program is to help youths succeed at home, at school, and within the community.
Sheriff
Find resources related to the Chippewa County Sheriff's Office.
Veterans Services
This office provides services to all veterans, their dependents, and survivors of veterans.

Countryside Public Health
Countryside Public Health is a five county Community Health service agency serving the counties of Big Stone, Chippewa, Lac qui Parle, Swift and Yellow Medicine in western Minnesota.
